name: article-index-blog
purpose: Every article of the blog as one ruled list, with the controls to narrow it on one row: a category picker and a search field. Each article is a row — its cover on the left, and on the right its overline, headline, a two-line deck and its writers with the byline pinned to the foot; the row is one link named by its headline, and from `lg` up a read cue rises into its end on hover or keyboard focus. The category and the search combine; a load-more button closes the list. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'article-index-blog', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `toggle-group`, `input`, `avatar` and `button`; the selected category and the search term are local state.
useWhen: For the blog's full list of posts, filtered by category and searched by text.
avoidWhen: For a resource hub filtered by facet dropdowns, with centred rows and no byline → use `article-index-resource-hub`.
For a closing row of related articles → use `article-cards`.
related: article-index-resource-hub` — the sibling listing with facet dropdowns.
article-highlight` — the band that opens the blog above this list.
bestPractices: List the articles newest first; file every article under at least one of `categories`.
Keep the category list short enough to scroll on one row.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: items
props.doc: The articles, newest first; each is `{ key, href, image, meta, title, description, authors?, byline?, categories? }`.

props.name: categories
props.doc: Segments of the category picker after the show-all segment; the picker is omitted when empty.

props.name: allLabel
props.doc: Label of the first segment, which shows every category.

props.name: categoryLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the category picker.

props.name: search
props.doc: The search field's `placeholder` and accessible `label`; the field is omitted when absent.

props.name: rowLabel
props.doc: Read cue revealed at the end of a row under hover or focus.

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Label of the load-more button under the list; the button is omitted when empty.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of articles.
